newsitem.title: FRANCE: Japan's Aso sees 1996 GDP above 2.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Aso sees 1996 GDP above 2.5 pct.

text.p: Japan's minister for economic planning Taro Aso said on Tuesday that the fiscal 1996 gross domestic product (GDP) figure due to be released early next month would be above 2.5 percent.
"Growth above 2.5 percent this year will be published early next month," Aso, in Paris for the OECD annual meeting, told reporters. The fiscal 1996 year ended in March.
He reaffirmed the fiscal 1997 growth forecast of 1.9 pct.
He said, referring to interest rates, "I think 0.5 percent is much lower than usual. But when it will be raised is beyond my limitations."
